description: Retrieval evaluation set for the FinSense AI sample documents. A chunk is relevant to a question when it contains one of the question's `snippets` (case- and whitespace-insensitive). Labelling by snippet rather than chunk id keeps the labels valid when chunking settings change. Questions marked split=holdout were written before retrieval settings were tuned on the dev questions and are reported separately to show whether tuning overfit.
